units.source_text: 应该出发了，几乎可以说成是振翅待发。

en.t: It was time to set out, almost as if I were poised to beat my wings and take flight.

units.source_text: 总之，我必须从我的环境中，从束缚着我的美的观念中，从我的坎坷不幸中，从我的结巴中，从我的存在条件中出发了。

en.t: In short, I had to set out from my surroundings, from the idea of beauty that bound me, from my misfortunes, from my stutter, and from the very conditions of my existence.
